faq.headline: Answers in 30 seconds.
faq.q1: How long does a display repair take?
faq.a1: For iPhone X through 17 and most Galaxy S models, display replacement takes about 30 minutes. You can wait or pick up later. Older or rarer models may take 1 to 2 business days.
faq.q2: Do I get original parts or aftermarket parts?
faq.a2: We offer both. Original Refurbished displays for full True-Tone and Service-Pack quality, or premium aftermarket parts as a cheaper alternative. We discuss the choice before repair.
faq.q3: Is there a warranty on the repair?
faq.a3: Yes, 12 months on every replaced part and our workmanship. We guarantee battery capacity, display function and color accuracy.
faq.q4: Can I walk in without an appointment?
faq.a4: Yes, no appointment needed. We recommend calling first (0660 6071414) so we can confirm we have the right part in stock for your model.
faq.a5: Diagnosis is always free and non-committal. If you decide against the repair, you pay nothing.
faq.q6: Do you accept Apple Care or insurance?
faq.a6: Yes, we settle directly with most phone insurance providers and issue Apple-Care-compliant invoices. We also offer framework contracts for business customers.
faq.a7: Yes, from iPhone 4 up to iPhone 17, Samsung Galaxy S5 upwards, Xiaomi Mi 5 upwards. For rare models the part lead time can be 1 to 3 business days.
faq.q8: Can I send in my device?
faq.a8: Yes, anywhere in Austria. Use the online form, we send you a prepaid shipping label and ship the device back after the repair.
